question: Berapa rasio pelanggan yang pernah punya deal won dibanding seluruh pelanggan?
sql: SELECT round(countIf(c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won')) / count(), 2) AS rasio_pelanggan_won FROM customers AS c FINAL

question: persen customer yg pernah bikin tiket urgent dari total customer brp?
sql: SELECT round(countIf(c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent')) / count(), 2) AS rasio_pelanggan_urgent FROM customers AS c FINAL

question: Rasio pelanggan yang pernah ikut demo terhadap semua pelanggan, per segmen.
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(countIf(c.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'demo')) / count(), 2) AS rasio_pernah_demo FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.segment

question: per wilayah pelanggan, brp proporsi pelanggan yg masih punya tiket open atau in_progress?
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, round(countIf(c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress'))) / count(), 2) AS rasio_tiket_belum_selesai FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY wilayah

question: Untuk tiap tier, hitung jumlah pelanggan yang punya deal lost dan total pelanggannya.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, countIf(c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost')) AS pelanggan_punya_lost, count() AS total_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY tier

question: rasio pelanggan aktif yg punya deal di pipeline vs semua pelanggan aktif
sql: SELECT round(countIf(c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation'))) / count(), 2) AS rasio_punya_pipeline FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'active'

question: Berapa persen pelanggan Enterprise yang pernah punya deal bernilai lebih dari 400 ribu?
sql: SELECT round(countIf(c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.value > 400000)) / count(), 2) AS rasio_deal_besar FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise'

question: proporsi pelanggan yg pernah dihubungi via meeting dalam 90 hari terakhir dibanding semua pelanggan
sql: SELECT round(countIf(c.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'meeting' AND a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 90))) / count(), 2) AS rasio_meeting_90_hari FROM customers AS c FINAL

question: Per segmen: jumlah pelanggan yang pernah punya tiket high atau urgent, dan rasionya terhadap seluruh pelanggan segmen itu.
sql: SELECT c.segment, countIf(c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority IN ('high','urgent'))) AS pelanggan_tiket_prioritas, round(countIf(c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority IN ('high','urgent'))) / count(), 2) AS rasio FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.segment

question: berapa banyak pelanggan yg pernah won DAN pernah lost?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost')

question: Tampilkan pelanggan yang deal terakhirnya berstatus lost.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT x.customer_id AS customer_id FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, d.stage, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 AND x.stage = 'lost') AS last_deal ON c.customer_id = last_deal.customer_id

question: list customer yg deal paling barunya won, khusus segmen SMB
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT x.customer_id AS customer_id FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, d.stage, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 AND x.stage = 'won') AS last_deal ON c.customer_id = last_deal.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'SMB'

question: Cari pelanggan yang deal terakhirnya lost, sertakan nilai deal terakhir tersebut.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, last_deal.value AS nilai_deal_terakhir FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT x.customer_id AS customer_id, x.value AS value FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, d.stage, d.value, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 AND x.stage = 'lost') AS last_deal ON c.customer_id = last_deal.customer_id

question: pelanggan mana yg deal terakhirnya masih negotiation?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING argMax(d.stage, d.created_date) = 'negotiation')

question: Siapa saja pelanggan yang tiket terakhirnya masih open?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id HAVING argMax(t.status, t.created_at) = 'open')

question: tampilin customer yg aktivitas terakhirnya bersentimen negatif
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id HAVING argMax(a.sentiment, a.timestamp) = 'negative')

question: Sales mana yang aktivitas terbarunya berupa demo?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.rep_id IN (SELECT a.rep_id FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.rep_id HAVING argMax(a.type, a.timestamp) = 'demo')

question: Cari tiket urgent milik pelanggan yang deal terakhirnya lost.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.customer_id IN (SELECT x.customer_id FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, d.stage, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 AND x.stage = 'lost')

question: berapa pelanggan yg deal terakhirnya lost tapi sebelumnya pernah won?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING argMax(d.stage, d.created_date) = 'lost' AND countIf(d.stage = 'won') > 0)

question: Pelanggan yang tiket terbarunya berprioritas urgent, cukup id dan nama.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id HAVING argMax(t.priority, t.created_at) = 'urgent')

question: Tampilkan deal terbaru tiap pelanggan Enterprise yang berstatus lost.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.deal_id IN (SELECT x.deal_id FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.stage, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise')) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 AND x.stage = 'lost')

question: Siapa pelanggan top 5% berdasarkan total omset?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, o.total_omset FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.total_omset >= (SELECT quantile(0.95)(p.total_omset) FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS p)

question: pelanggan mana aja yg total omsetnya di atas persentil 90?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, o.total_omset FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.total_omset > (SELECT quantile(0.9)(p.total_omset) FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS p)

question: Sales mana yang jumlah deal won-nya masuk 10% teratas?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, w.jumlah_won FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN (SELECT d.rep_id AS rep_id, count() AS jumlah_won FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id) AS w ON r.rep_id = w.rep_id WHERE w.jumlah_won >= (SELECT quantile(0.9)(p.jumlah_won) FROM (SELECT d.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_won FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id) AS p)

question: customer yg jumlah tiketnya di atas median jumlah tiket per customer, tampilkan id, nama, jumlah tiket
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, tk.jumlah_tiket FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT t.customer_id AS customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS tk ON c.customer_id = tk.customer_id WHERE tk.jumlah_tiket > (SELECT quantile(0.5)(p.jumlah_tiket) FROM (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS p)

question: Pelanggan dengan total durasi aktivitas di atas persentil 95 dari total durasi per pelanggan.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, ac.total_durasi FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT a.customer_id AS customer_id, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id) AS ac ON c.customer_id = ac.customer_id WHERE ac.total_durasi > (SELECT quantile(0.95)(p.total_durasi) FROM (SELECT a.customer_id, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id) AS p)

question: Tampilkan deal won yang nilainya masuk 5% terbesar dari semua deal won.

question: Sales dengan total forecast pipeline di atas persentil 75 antar sales, sertakan nilai forecast-nya.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, f.total_forecast FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN (SELECT d.rep_id AS rep_id, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS total_forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d.rep_id) AS f ON r.rep_id = f.rep_id WHERE f.total_forecast > (SELECT quantile(0.75)(p.total_forecast) FROM (SELECT d.rep_id, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS total_forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d.rep_id) AS p)

question: pelanggan yg rata2 nilai deal-nya di atas persentil 90 rata2 per pelanggan
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, v.rata_nilai FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id, avg(d.value) AS rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS v ON c.customer_id = v.customer_id WHERE v.rata_nilai > (SELECT quantile(0.9)(p.rata_nilai) FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, avg(d.value) AS rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS p)

question: Cari pelanggan SMB yang total omsetnya lebih dari median total omset seluruh pelanggan.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, o.total_omset FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'SMB' AND o.total_omset > (SELECT quantile(0.5)(p.total_omset) FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS p)

question: sales yg rata-rata durasi aktivitasnya masuk 20% terlama, id, nama, dan rata-ratanya
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, s.rata_durasi FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN (SELECT a.rep_id AS rep_id, avg(a.duration_minutes) AS rata_durasi FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.rep_id) AS s ON r.rep_id = s.rep_id WHERE s.rata_durasi >= (SELECT quantile(0.8)(p.rata_durasi) FROM (SELECT a.rep_id, avg(a.duration_minutes) AS rata_durasi FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.rep_id) AS p)

question: Pelanggan yang jumlah deal lost-nya melebihi persentil 90 jumlah deal lost per pelanggan.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, l.jumlah_lost FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id, count() AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS l ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.jumlah_lost > (SELECT quantile(0.9)(p.jumlah_lost) FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS p)

question: tiket yg waktu penyelesaiannya di atas persentil 95 semua tiket resolved

question: Berapa jumlah pelanggan yang total omsetnya masuk 5% teratas?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS o WHERE o.total_omset >= (SELECT quantile(0.95)(p.total_omset) FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS p)

question: Pelanggan yang total omsetnya di atas rata-rata total omset per pelanggan, tampilkan id, nama, dan total omset.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, o.total_omset FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.total_omset > (SELECT avg(p.total_omset) FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS p)

question: sales yg omset tahun ini lebih tinggi dari rata-rata omset semua sales tahun ini
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, o.total_omset FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN (SELECT d.rep_id AS rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY d.rep_id) AS o ON r.rep_id = o.rep_id WHERE o.total_omset > (SELECT avg(p.total_omset) FROM (SELECT d.rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY d.rep_id) AS p)

question: Bandingkan rata-rata nilai deal won antara pelanggan yang total omsetnya di atas 2 juta dan pelanggan lainnya.
sql: SELECT avgIf(d.value, d.customer_id IN (SELECT o.customer_id FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS o WHERE o.total_omset > 2000000)) AS rata_nilai_di_atas, avgIf(d.value, d.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT o.customer_id FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS o WHERE o.total_omset > 2000000)) AS rata_nilai_lainnya FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: rata2 waktu penyelesaian tiket resolved: pelanggan yg punya deal lost vs yg tidak punya
sql: SELECT avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, t.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost')) AS rata_jam_punya_lost, avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, t.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost')) AS rata_jam_tanpa_lost FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'resolved'

question: Bandingkan total durasi aktivitas antara pelanggan yang punya tiket urgent dan yang tidak.
sql: SELECT sumIf(a.duration_minutes, a.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent')) AS durasi_punya_urgent, sumIf(a.duration_minutes, a.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent')) AS durasi_tanpa_urgent FROM activities AS a

question: Jumlah tiket per prioritas dari pelanggan yang pernah won vs yang belum pernah won, dalam satu baris tiap prioritas.
sql: SELECT t.priority, countIf(t.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won')) AS tiket_pelanggan_won, countIf(t.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won')) AS tiket_pelanggan_belum_won FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority

question: rata-rata nilai deal pelanggan Enterprise vs bukan Enterprise
sql: SELECT avgIf(d.value, d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise')) AS rata_enterprise, avgIf(d.value, d.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise')) AS rata_non_enterprise FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: Hitung jumlah aktivitas negatif dari pelanggan yang punya tag high-value dibanding pelanggan tanpa tag itu.
sql: SELECT countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative' AND a.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE has(c.tags, 'high-value'))) AS negatif_high_value, countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative' AND a.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE has(c.tags, 'high-value'))) AS negatif_lainnya FROM activities AS a

question: bandingin rata2 probability deal pipeline: customer yg pernah ada tiket urgent vs sisanya
sql: SELECT avgIf(d.probability, d.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent')) AS rata_prob_urgent, avgIf(d.probability, d.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent')) AS rata_prob_sisanya FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')

question: Total omset dari pelanggan yang di atas rata-rata total omset vs dari pelanggan yang di bawah/sama dengan rata-rata.
sql: SELECT sumIf(d.value, d.customer_id IN (SELECT o.customer_id FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS o WHERE o.total_omset > (SELECT avg(p.total_omset) FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS p))) AS omset_di_atas_rata, sumIf(d.value, d.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT o.customer_id FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS o WHERE o.total_omset > (SELECT avg(p.total_omset) FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS p))) AS omset_lainnya FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: Berapa jumlah deal lost dari pelanggan yang punya tiket urgent, dan berapa dari pelanggan yang tidak punya?
sql: SELECT countIf(d.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent')) AS lost_punya_urgent, countIf(d.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent')) AS lost_tanpa_urgent FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost'

question: pelanggan yg belum pernah punya tiket, list aja

question: pelanggan yg punya deal won tapi belum pernah ada aktivitas demo

question: Tampilkan id dan nama pelanggan yang tidak punya tiket yang masih terbuka.

question: Deal pipeline milik pelanggan yang belum pernah komplain (tidak ada tiket).

question: Hitung pelanggan prospect yang tidak pernah dikontak lewat call.

question: Segmen mana yang rata-rata nilai deal-nya di atas rata-rata seluruh deal?

question: tim sales mana yg rata2 durasi aktivitasnya lebih dari rata2 keseluruhan?

question: Sales mana yang jumlah deal-nya di atas rata-rata jumlah deal per sales?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING count() > (SELECT avg(p.jumlah_deal) FROM (SELECT d.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.rep_id) AS p)

question: wilayah sales mana yg omsetnya di atas rata-rata omset antar wilayah?
sql: SELECT r.region, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.region HAVING sum(d.value) > (SELECT avg(p.total_omset) FROM (SELECT r.region, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.region) AS p)

question: Perusahaan mana yang rata-rata waktu penyelesaian tiketnya lebih lama dari rata-rata semua tiket?
sql: SELECT c.company, avg(t.resolution_time_hours) AS rata_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.company HAVING avg(t.resolution_time_hours) > (SELECT avg(t.resolution_time_hours) FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL)

question: Tampilkan deal dengan nilai di atas rata-rata nilai deal dalam stage yang sama.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.stage AS stage, avg(d.value) AS rata_stage FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.stage) AS s ON d.stage = s.stage WHERE d.value > s.rata_stage

question: pelanggan yg jumlah aktivitasnya lebih banyak dari rata2 jumlah aktivitas per pelanggan, id nama dan jumlahnya
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, ac.jumlah_aktivitas FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT a.customer_id AS customer_id, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id) AS ac ON c.customer_id = ac.customer_id WHERE ac.jumlah_aktivitas > (SELECT avg(p.jumlah_aktivitas) FROM (SELECT a.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id) AS p)

question: Tampilkan aktivitas dengan durasi di atas rata-rata durasi tipe aktivitasnya sendiri.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT a.type AS type, avg(a.duration_minutes) AS rata_tipe FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type) AS s ON a.type = s.type WHERE a.duration_minutes > s.rata_tipe

question: Segmen dengan total pipeline lebih besar dari rata-rata total pipeline antar segmen.
sql: SELECT c.segment, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY c.segment HAVING sum(d.value) > (SELECT avg(p.total_pipeline) FROM (SELECT c.segment, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY c.segment) AS p)

question: Tim mana yang win rate-nya di atas win rate keseluruhan?
sql: SELECT r.team, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team HAVING countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) > (SELECT countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) FROM deals AS d FINAL)

question: Pakai CTE: tampilkan pelanggan dengan total omset di atas rata-rata total omset per pelanggan.
sql: WITH omset_pelanggan AS (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, op.total_omset FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN omset_pelanggan AS op ON c.customer_id = op.customer_id WHERE op.total_omset > (SELECT avg(x.total_omset) FROM omset_pelanggan AS x)

question: pake CTE, sales dgn jumlah deal lost di atas rata-rata jumlah lost per sales, id nama jumlahnya
sql: WITH lost_sales AS (SELECT d.rep_id AS rep_id, count() AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost' GROUP BY d.rep_id) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, ls.jumlah_lost FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN lost_sales AS ls ON r.rep_id = ls.rep_id WHERE ls.jumlah_lost > (SELECT avg(x.jumlah_lost) FROM lost_sales AS x)

question: deal yang ditangani sales tim Inbound
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.rep_id IN (SELECT r.rep_id FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.team = 'Inbound')

question: Tampilkan tiket dari pelanggan segmen Enterprise.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise')

question: aktivitas dari customer yg statusnya churned
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp FROM activities AS a WHERE a.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned')

question: Pelanggan yang punya deal won dan tiket urgent sekaligus.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent')

question: customer yg pernah dikunjungi sales wilayah EMEA (ada aktivitasnya), list
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.rep_id IN (SELECT r.rep_id FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.region = 'EMEA'))

question: Berapa jumlah deal milik pelanggan yang berstatus active?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'active')

question: total omset dari pelanggan yg punya tag strategic
sql: SELECT sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE has(c.tags, 'strategic'))

question: Tampilkan deal dengan nilai tertinggi di antara seluruh deal won.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.value = (SELECT max(d.value) FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won')

question: tiket terlama (resolution time paling tinggi) itu yg mana? tampilin tiketnya
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, t.resolution_time_hours FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.resolution_time_hours = (SELECT max(t.resolution_time_hours) FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL)

question: Deal yang dibuat pada tanggal pembuatan deal paling akhir.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.created_date FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.created_date = (SELECT max(d.created_date) FROM deals AS d FINAL)

question: Pelanggan yang punya lebih banyak deal lost daripada deal won.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING countIf(d.stage = 'lost') > countIf(d.stage = 'won'))

question: customer mana yg total nilai deal won-nya lebih dari 1 juta tapi tiket urgent-nya lebih dari 1?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING sum(d.value) > 1000000) AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' GROUP BY t.customer_id HAVING count() > 1)

question: Sales yang memiliki deal won pada pelanggan Enterprise dan juga deal won pada pelanggan SMB.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.rep_id IN (SELECT d.rep_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise')) AND r.rep_id IN (SELECT d.rep_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'SMB'))

question: Pelanggan dengan tiket high yang belum selesai (open/in_progress), tampilkan daftar pelanggannya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'high' AND t.status IN ('open','in_progress'))

question: Pelanggan yang deal won terbarunya bernilai di atas rata-rata nilai deal won, id dan nama saja.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT x.customer_id FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, d.value, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.closed_date DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 AND x.value > (SELECT avg(d.value) FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'))

question: pelanggan yg deal won pertamanya terjadi tahun ini
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING min(d.closed_date) >= toStartOfYear(today()))

question: Tampilkan pelanggan yang aktivitas terakhirnya lebih dari 60 hari lalu.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id HAVING max(a.timestamp) < subtractDays(now(), 60))

question: Pelanggan yang tiket terakhirnya resolved tapi deal terakhirnya lost.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id HAVING argMax(t.status, t.created_at) = 'resolved') AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING argMax(d.stage, d.created_date) = 'lost')

question: brp pelanggan yg total omset won-nya di bawah rata2 total omset per pelanggan (hanya yg punya deal won)
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS o WHERE o.total_omset < (SELECT avg(p.total_omset) FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS p)

question: Deal pipeline dengan probability lebih tinggi dari rata-rata probability deal pipeline.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.probability FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND d.probability > (SELECT avg(d.probability) FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation'))

question: Sales dengan omset tertinggi, tampilkan id, nama, dan omsetnya.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, o.total_omset FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN (SELECT d.rep_id AS rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id) AS o ON r.rep_id = o.rep_id WHERE o.total_omset = (SELECT max(p.total_omset) FROM (SELECT d.rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id) AS p)

question: pelanggan dgn jumlah tiket terbanyak, id nama sama jumlah tiketnya
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, tk.jumlah_tiket FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT t.customer_id AS customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS tk ON c.customer_id = tk.customer_id WHERE tk.jumlah_tiket = (SELECT max(p.jumlah_tiket) FROM (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS p)

question: Tampilkan omset per bulan untuk tiap wilayah sales beserta omset kumulatifnya.
sql: SELECT r.region, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset_bulanan, sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.region, bulan ORDER BY r.region, bulan

question: total omset kumulatif per bulan tahun ini, tampilkan juga omset bulanannya
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset_bulanan, sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Jumlah tiket baru per bulan per prioritas dan akumulasinya sepanjang waktu.
sql: SELECT t.priority, toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_tiket, sum(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY t.priority ORDER BY bulan) AS tiket_kumulatif FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority, bulan ORDER BY t.priority, bulan

question: running total durasi aktivitas per minggu untuk tiap tipe aktivitas, sertakan durasi mingguannya
sql: SELECT a.type, toStartOfWeek(a.timestamp, 1) AS minggu, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS durasi_mingguan, sum(sum(a.duration_minutes)) OVER (PARTITION BY a.type ORDER BY minggu) AS durasi_kumulatif FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractWeeks(now(), 12) GROUP BY a.type, minggu ORDER BY a.type, minggu

question: Pertumbuhan pelanggan baru per bulan beserta jumlah kumulatif pelanggan, per segmen.
sql: SELECT c.segment, toStartOfMonth(c.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS pelanggan_baru, sum(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY bulan) AS pelanggan_kumulatif FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.segment, bulan ORDER BY c.segment, bulan

question: akumulasi omset per kuartal tiap tim sales, kolomnya tim, kuartal, omset kuartal, omset akumulasi
sql: SELECT r.team, toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal, sum(d.value) AS omset_kuartal, sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY kuartal) AS omset_akumulasi FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team, kuartal ORDER BY r.team, kuartal

question: Total deal baru dibuat per bulan dan jumlah kumulatifnya, hanya tahun 2025.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.created_date) AS bulan, count() AS deal_baru, sum(count()) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS deal_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE toYear(d.created_date) = 2025 GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: omset per hari 14 hari terakhir plus total berjalan
sql: SELECT toDate(d.closed_date) AS hari, sum(d.value) AS omset_harian, sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY hari) AS omset_berjalan FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= subtractDays(now(), 14) GROUP BY hari ORDER BY hari

question: Per sales, tampilkan omset bulanan dan omset kumulatifnya untuk 6 bulan terakhir.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset_bulanan, sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.rep_id ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= subtractMonths(now(), 6) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, bulan ORDER BY r.rep_id, bulan

question: Kumulatif jam penyelesaian tiket resolved per bulan, dengan total jam per bulannya.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, sum(t.resolution_time_hours) AS jam_bulanan, sum(sum(t.resolution_time_hours)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS jam_kumulatif FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'resolved' GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: nilai forecast pipeline kumulatif per bulan pembuatan deal, per tim
sql: SELECT r.team, toStartOfMonth(d.created_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS forecast_bulanan, sum(sum(d.value * d.probability / 100)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY bulan) AS forecast_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY r.team, bulan ORDER BY r.team, bulan

question: Berapa aktivitas per bulan, dan persentase kumulatifnya terhadap total aktivitas sepanjang waktu?
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(a.timestamp) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, round(sum(count()) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) / sum(count()) OVER (), 2) AS rasio_kumulatif FROM activities AS a GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Beri peringkat sales berdasarkan total omset, dari terbesar.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY peringkat

question: ranking segmen pelanggan berdasarkan jumlah deal won
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_won, rank() OVER (ORDER BY count() DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY peringkat

question: Peringkat tim sales berdasarkan rata-rata nilai deal won.
sql: SELECT r.team, avg(d.value) AS rata_nilai, rank() OVER (ORDER BY avg(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY peringkat

question: kasih ranking pelanggan berdasarkan jumlah tiket, yg paling banyak nomor 1
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_tiket, rank() OVER (ORDER BY count() DESC) AS peringkat FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY peringkat

question: Urutkan wilayah sales dengan dense rank berdasarkan total pipeline.
sql: SELECT r.region, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY peringkat

question: Peringkat sales di dalam timnya masing-masing berdasarkan omset.
sql: SELECT r.team, r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat_dalam_tim FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team, r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY r.team, peringkat_dalam_tim

question: ranking pelanggan per segmen berdasarkan total omset won
sql: SELECT c.segment, c.customer_id, c.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat_segmen FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment, c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY c.segment, peringkat_segmen

question: Peringkat bulan dalam tiap tahun berdasarkan jumlah tiket yang masuk.
sql: SELECT toYear(t.created_at) AS tahun, toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_tiket, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY tahun ORDER BY count() DESC) AS peringkat FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY tahun, bulan ORDER BY tahun, peringkat

question: nomor urut sales berdasarkan jumlah aktivitas terbanyak
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY count() DESC) AS nomor_urut FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY nomor_urut

question: Peringkat produk berdasarkan total nilai deal won.
sql: SELECT product, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY product ORDER BY peringkat

question: tiap tim, ranking wilayah berdasar jumlah deal lost
sql: SELECT r.team, r.region, count() AS jumlah_lost, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY count() DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'lost' GROUP BY r.team, r.region ORDER BY r.team, peringkat

question: Tampilkan 3 sales dengan omset tertinggi di setiap tim.
sql: SELECT x.team, x.rep_id, x.name, x.total_omset FROM (SELECT r.team AS team, r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team, r.rep_id, r.name) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 3 ORDER BY x.team, x.rn

question: top 2 pelanggan per segmen yg tiketnya paling banyak
sql: SELECT x.segment, x.customer_id, x.name, x.jumlah_tiket FROM (SELECT c.segment AS segment, c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS name, count() AS jumlah_tiket, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY count() DESC) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment, c.customer_id, c.name) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 2 ORDER BY x.segment, x.rn

question: Bulan dengan omset tertinggi di tiap tahun, tampilkan tahun, bulan, dan omsetnya.
sql: SELECT x.tahun, x.bulan, x.omset FROM (SELECT toYear(d.closed_date) AS tahun, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY toYear(d.closed_date) ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY tahun, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.tahun

question: Sales terbaik (omset terbesar) di tiap wilayah, id, nama, wilayah, omset.
sql: SELECT x.rep_id, x.name, x.region, x.total_omset FROM (SELECT r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS name, r.region AS region, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, r.region) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.region

question: per tipe aktivitas, 3 pelanggan yg total durasinya paling lama
sql: SELECT x.type, x.customer_id, x.name, x.total_durasi FROM (SELECT a.type AS type, c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS name, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.type ORDER BY sum(a.duration_minutes) DESC) AS rn FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY a.type, c.customer_id, c.name) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 3 ORDER BY x.type, x.rn

question: Deal won terbesar untuk setiap pelanggan Enterprise.
sql: SELECT x.customer_id, x.name, x.deal_id, x.title, x.value FROM (SELECT c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS name, d.deal_id AS deal_id, d.title AS title, d.value AS value, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise') AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: ambil 2 bulan dgn tiket urgent terbanyak di tiap tahun, kolomnya tahun, bulan, jumlah_urgent
sql: SELECT x.tahun, x.bulan, x.jumlah_urgent FROM (SELECT toYear(t.created_at) AS tahun, toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_urgent, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY toYear(t.created_at) ORDER BY count() DESC) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' GROUP BY tahun, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 2 ORDER BY x.tahun, x.rn

question: Pelanggan yang total omsetnya masuk 5% teratas (bagi jadi 20 kelompok, ambil kelompok pertama), id nama dan omsetnya.
sql: SELECT x.customer_id, x.name, x.total_omset FROM (SELECT c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, ntile(20) OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS kelompok FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name) AS x WHERE x.kelompok = 1

question: sales yg omsetnya di kuartil paling atas (ntile 4), tampilkan id, nama, omset
sql: SELECT x.rep_id, x.name, x.total_omset FROM (SELECT r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, ntile(4) OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS kuartil FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name) AS x WHERE x.kuartil = 1

question: Tampilkan sales yang peringkat omsetnya 5 besar saja.
sql: SELECT x.rep_id, x.name, x.total_omset, x.peringkat FROM (SELECT r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name) AS x WHERE x.peringkat <= 5 ORDER BY x.peringkat

question: Tampilkan deal yang nilainya lebih besar dari rata-rata nilai semua deal milik pelanggan yang sama.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value FROM (SELECT d.deal_id AS deal_id, d.title AS title, d.stage AS stage, d.value AS value, avg(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id) AS rata_pelanggan FROM deals AS d FINAL) AS x WHERE x.value > x.rata_pelanggan

question: Bulan-bulan dimana omset bulanan di atas rata-rata omset bulanan keseluruhan.
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.omset FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, avg(sum(d.value)) OVER () AS rata_bulanan FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.omset > x.rata_bulanan ORDER BY x.bulan

question: bulan mana yg jumlah tiketnya di atas median bulanan?
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.jumlah_tiket FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.jumlah_tiket > (SELECT quantile(0.5)(y.jumlah_tiket) FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY bulan) AS y) ORDER BY x.bulan

question: Tampilkan satu aktivitas terakhir untuk setiap pelanggan.
sql: SELECT x.activity_id, x.customer_id, x.rep_id, x.type, x.timestamp FROM (SELECT a.activity_id AS activity_id, a.customer_id AS customer_id, a.rep_id AS rep_id, a.type AS type, a.timestamp AS timestamp, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM activities AS a) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Tampilkan tiket urgent terbaru untuk tiap pelanggan (satu tiket per pelanggan).
sql: SELECT x.ticket_id, x.customer_id, x.priority, x.status, x.created_at FROM (SELECT t.ticket_id AS ticket_id, t.customer_id AS customer_id, t.priority AS priority, t.status AS status, t.created_at AS created_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at DESC) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent') AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Selisih omset tiap bulan dibanding bulan sebelumnya, tanpa menampilkan bulan pertama.
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.omset, x.omset - x.omset_sebelumnya AS selisih FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS omset_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.bulan

question: pertumbuhan jumlah tiket per bulan vs bulan lalunya (bulan pertama jangan ditampilkan)
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.jumlah_tiket, x.jumlah_tiket - x.tiket_sebelumnya AS pertumbuhan FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_tiket, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY bulan ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS tiket_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.bulan

question: Perubahan omset per kuartal dibanding kuartal sebelumnya untuk tiap tim, kuartal pertama tiap tim dibuang.
sql: SELECT x.team, x.kuartal, x.omset, x.omset - x.omset_sebelumnya AS perubahan FROM (SELECT r.team AS team, toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal, sum(d.value) AS omset, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY kuartal ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS omset_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY kuartal) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team, kuartal) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.team, x.kuartal

question: Jumlah aktivitas per minggu dan selisihnya dengan minggu sebelumnya; minggu pertama tetap ditampilkan, dibandingkan dengan 0.
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(a.timestamp, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, count() - lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY minggu ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS selisih FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractWeeks(now(), 10) GROUP BY minggu ORDER BY minggu

question: Berapa rasio kenaikan jumlah deal baru tiap bulan dibanding bulan sebelumnya? (bulan pertama dilewati)
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.deal_baru, round((x.deal_baru - x.sebelumnya) / x.sebelumnya, 2) AS pertumbuhan FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.created_date) AS bulan, count() AS deal_baru, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY bulan ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 AND x.sebelumnya > 0 ORDER BY x.bulan

question: Kontribusi tiap segmen terhadap total omset (proporsi 0-1), tampilkan omset segmennya juga.
sql: SELECT c.segment, sum(d.value) AS omset_segmen, round(sum(d.value) / sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (), 2) AS kontribusi FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY omset_segmen DESC

question: proporsi jumlah tiket tiap prioritas dari seluruh tiket
sql: SELECT t.priority, count() AS jumlah_tiket, round(count() / sum(count()) OVER (), 2) AS proporsi FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority

question: Berapa porsi omset tiap sales terhadap omset timnya?
sql: SELECT r.team, r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS omset_sales, round(sum(d.value) / sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team), 2) AS porsi_dalam_tim FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team, r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY r.team, omset_sales DESC

question: porsi tiap tipe aktivitas terhadap total durasi, plus total menitnya
sql: SELECT a.type, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_menit, round(sum(a.duration_minutes) / sum(sum(a.duration_minutes)) OVER (), 2) AS porsi FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type

question: Rata-rata bergerak 3 bulan dari omset bulanan, tampilkan omset bulanannya juga.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset_bulanan, round(avg(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS rata_bergerak_3_bulan FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: moving average 4 minggu jumlah tiket mingguan (kolom minggu, jumlah_tiket, rata_bergerak)
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(t.created_at, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_tiket, round(avg(count()) OVER (ORDER BY minggu ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS rata_bergerak FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= subtractWeeks(now(), 16) GROUP BY minggu ORDER BY minggu

question: Persentase omset tiap bulan terhadap total omset tahun 2025, per bulan.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset_bulanan, round(sum(d.value) / sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (), 2) AS porsi_tahunan FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND toYear(d.closed_date) = 2025 GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: omset tertinggi sejauh ini (running max) tiap bulan
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset_bulanan, max(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS omset_tertinggi_sejauh_ini FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Selisih omset tiap sales dengan rata-rata omset semua sales.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, round(sum(d.value) - avg(sum(d.value)) OVER (), 2) AS selisih_dari_rata FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY selisih_dari_rata DESC

question: Untuk tiap deal won, tampilkan nilai total omset won pelanggannya di sampingnya.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, sum(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id) AS omset_pelanggan FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: nomor urut deal tiap pelanggan berdasarkan tanggal closing, khusus deal won
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.closed_date) AS urutan_won FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' ORDER BY d.customer_id, urutan_won

question: Tampilkan deal pertama yang di-won oleh setiap sales, dengan nama sales-nya.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.rep_name FROM (SELECT d.deal_id AS deal_id, d.title AS title, d.stage AS stage, d.value AS value, r.name AS rep_name, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.rep_id ORDER BY d.closed_date) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Tiket yang waktu penyelesaiannya paling lama di tiap prioritas, satu tiket per prioritas.
sql: SELECT x.ticket_id, x.customer_id, x.priority, x.status, x.created_at, x.resolution_time_hours FROM (SELECT t.ticket_id AS ticket_id, t.customer_id AS customer_id, t.priority AS priority, t.status AS status, t.created_at AS created_at, t.resolution_time_hours AS resolution_time_hours, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.priority ORDER BY t.resolution_time_hours DESC) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.resolution_time_hours IS NOT NULL) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: total berjalan nilai deal won, diurutkan dari nilai terkecil, per deal
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, sum(d.value) OVER (ORDER BY d.value, d.deal_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS total_berjalan FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: Untuk tiap pelanggan yang punya deal won, berapa hari sejak deal won sebelumnya ke deal won berikutnya? tampilkan hanya deal won kedua dan seterusnya (id deal, id pelanggan, selisih hari).
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.customer_id, dateDiff('day', x.won_sebelumnya, x.closed_date) AS selisih_hari FROM (SELECT d.deal_id AS deal_id, d.customer_id AS customer_id, d.closed_date AS closed_date, lagInFrame(d.closed_date) OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.closed_date ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS won_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.closed_date) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS x WHERE x.rn > 1

question: jarak hari antara aktivitas berurutan tiap pelanggan, tampilkan 5 jarak terpanjang beserta id pelanggan
sql: SELECT x.customer_id, x.jarak_hari FROM (SELECT a.customer_id AS customer_id, dateDiff('day', lagInFrame(a.timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), a.timestamp) AS jarak_hari, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS rn FROM activities AS a) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.jarak_hari DESC LIMIT 5

question: Berapa rata-rata total omset per pelanggan?
sql: SELECT round(avg(o.total_omset), 2) AS rata_omset_per_pelanggan FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS o

question: rata2 jumlah tiket per pelanggan yg pernah bikin tiket, brp?
sql: SELECT round(avg(p.jumlah_tiket), 2) AS rata_tiket_per_pelanggan FROM (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS p

question: Jumlah deal terbanyak yang dimiliki satu sales itu berapa?
sql: SELECT max(p.jumlah_deal) AS deal_terbanyak FROM (SELECT d.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.rep_id) AS p

question: Berapa median total durasi aktivitas per pelanggan?
sql: SELECT quantile(0.5)(p.total_durasi) AS median_durasi FROM (SELECT a.customer_id, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id) AS p

question: persentil 90 dari omset per sales
sql: SELECT quantile(0.9)(p.total_omset) AS p90_omset_sales FROM (SELECT d.rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id) AS p

question: Untuk tiap segmen, rata-rata total omset per pelanggan (bukan rata-rata per deal).
sql: SELECT o.segment, round(avg(o.total_omset), 2) AS rata_omset_per_pelanggan FROM (SELECT c.segment AS segment, c.customer_id AS customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment, c.customer_id) AS o GROUP BY o.segment

question: per tim, rata2 jumlah deal per sales
sql: SELECT s.team, round(avg(s.jumlah_deal), 2) AS rata_deal_per_sales FROM (SELECT r.team AS team, r.rep_id AS rep_id, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team, r.rep_id) AS s GROUP BY s.team

question: Per wilayah pelanggan, jumlah tiket terbanyak yang dimiliki satu pelanggan.
sql: SELECT p.wilayah, max(p.jumlah_tiket) AS tiket_terbanyak FROM (SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, c.customer_id AS customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY wilayah, c.customer_id) AS p GROUP BY p.wilayah

question: Per tipe aktivitas, rata-rata jumlah aktivitas per pelanggan.
sql: SELECT p.type, round(avg(p.jumlah), 2) AS rata_per_pelanggan FROM (SELECT a.type AS type, a.customer_id AS customer_id, count() AS jumlah FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type, a.customer_id) AS p GROUP BY p.type

question: Per segmen, persentil 95 dari jumlah deal per pelanggan.
sql: SELECT p.segment, quantile(0.95)(p.jumlah_deal) AS p95_deal FROM (SELECT c.segment AS segment, c.customer_id AS customer_id, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment, c.customer_id) AS p GROUP BY p.segment

question: Segmen dengan jumlah deal lost di atas rata-rata jumlah lost per segmen.
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'lost' GROUP BY c.segment HAVING count() > (SELECT avg(p.jumlah_lost) FROM (SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'lost' GROUP BY c.segment) AS p)

question: perusahaan yg total omsetnya lebih dari 3 juta, urutkan dari terbesar
sql: SELECT c.company, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.company HAVING sum(d.value) > 3000000 ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Sales yang total omsetnya di atas rata-rata omset seluruh sales, tampilkan id, nama, omset.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING sum(d.value) > (SELECT avg(p.total_omset) FROM (SELECT d.rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id) AS p)

question: Tipe aktivitas mana yang jumlahnya di atas rata-rata jumlah aktivitas per tipe?
sql: SELECT a.type, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type HAVING count() > (SELECT avg(p.jumlah) FROM (SELECT a.type, count() AS jumlah FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type) AS p)

question: Wilayah pelanggan dengan rata-rata nilai deal won di atas rata-rata nilai deal won keseluruhan.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY wilayah HAVING avg(d.value) > (SELECT avg(d.value) FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won')

question: prioritas tiket mana yg rata2 jam penyelesaiannya di bawah rata2 semua tiket?
sql: SELECT t.priority, avg(t.resolution_time_hours) AS rata_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority HAVING avg(t.resolution_time_hours) < (SELECT avg(t.resolution_time_hours) FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL)

question: Industri pelanggan dengan jumlah tiket urgent di atas rata-rata jumlah tiket urgent per industri.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['industry'] AS industri, count() AS tiket_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' GROUP BY industri HAVING count() > (SELECT avg(p.jumlah) FROM (SELECT c.attributes['industry'] AS industri, count() AS jumlah FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' GROUP BY industri) AS p)

question: Tampilkan sales yang punya lebih dari 30 deal dan win rate di atas 0.4.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_deal, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING count() > 30 AND countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) > 0.4

question: Tim sales yang rata-rata omset per sales-nya lebih tinggi dari rata-rata omset per sales keseluruhan.
sql: SELECT s.team, round(avg(s.total_omset), 2) AS rata_omset_per_sales FROM (SELECT r.team AS team, r.rep_id AS rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team, r.rep_id) AS s GROUP BY s.team HAVING avg(s.total_omset) > (SELECT avg(p.total_omset) FROM (SELECT d.rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id) AS p)

question: Segmen yang rata-rata omset per pelanggannya di atas median omset per pelanggan (median dihitung dari semua pelanggan).
sql: SELECT o.segment, round(avg(o.total_omset), 2) AS rata_omset_per_pelanggan FROM (SELECT c.segment AS segment, c.customer_id AS customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment, c.customer_id) AS o GROUP BY o.segment HAVING avg(o.total_omset) > (SELECT quantile(0.5)(p.total_omset) FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS p)

question: Berapa jumlah pelanggan unik per perusahaan yang punya deal won?
sql: SELECT c.company, uniqExact(c.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.company

question: Per sales, tampilkan jumlah pelanggan unik yang ditangani dan total nilai dealnya.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, uniqExact(d.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan, sum(d.value) AS total_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name

question: rekap per segmen: jumlah pelanggan, jumlah deal, dan jumlah tiket (jangan dobel hitung)
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan, sum(dl.jumlah_deal) AS jumlah_deal, sum(tk.jumlah_tiket) AS jumlah_tiket FROM customers AS c FINAL LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS dl ON c.customer_id = dl.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.customer_id AS customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS tk ON c.customer_id = tk.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: Per tim, total omset dan total durasi aktivitas tiap tim (hindari penggandaan akibat join).
sql: SELECT r.team, sum(o.total_omset) AS total_omset, sum(ac.total_durasi) AS total_durasi FROM sales_reps AS r LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.rep_id AS rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id) AS o ON r.rep_id = o.rep_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.rep_id AS rep_id, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.rep_id) AS ac ON r.rep_id = ac.rep_id GROUP BY r.team

question: Pelanggan dengan lebih dari 3 tiket urgent, tampilkan id, nama, dan jumlahnya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING count() > 3

question: customer yg total durasi meeting-nya > 200 menit, id nama total menit
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_menit FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.type = 'meeting' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING sum(a.duration_minutes) > 200

question: Berapa jumlah deal per tim sales?
sql: SELECT r.team, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team

question: total nilai pipeline per segmen
sql: SELECT c.segment, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY c.segment

question: rata2 durasi aktivitas tiap tipe
sql: SELECT a.type, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_durasi FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type

question: Jumlah tiket per status.
sql: SELECT t.status, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.status

question: omset per wilayah sales, urutkan terbesar
sql: SELECT r.region, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: brp deal won per tahun?
sql: SELECT toYear(d.closed_date) AS tahun, count() AS jumlah_won FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY tahun

question: Rata-rata nilai deal per tag pelanggan, tampilkan tag dan rata-ratanya.
sql: SELECT tag, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id ARRAY JOIN c.tags AS tag GROUP BY tag

question: Per kuartal, jumlah pelanggan baru dan jumlah pelanggan baru yang statusnya churned.
sql: SELECT toStartOfQuarter(c.created_at) AS kuartal, count() AS pelanggan_baru, countIf(c.status = 'churned') AS pelanggan_churned FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY kuartal ORDER BY kuartal

question: sales yg punya lebih dari 20 pelanggan unik dgn deal lost, tampilkan id, nama, jumlah pelanggannya
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, uniqExact(d.customer_id) AS pelanggan_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'lost' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING uniqExact(d.customer_id) > 20

question: Untuk tiap tier pelanggan, rata-rata dari total omset per pelanggan dan maksimumnya.
sql: SELECT o.tier, round(avg(o.total_omset), 2) AS rata_omset, max(o.total_omset) AS omset_tertinggi FROM (SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, c.customer_id AS customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY tier, c.customer_id) AS o GROUP BY o.tier

question: Tampilkan pelanggan yang punya lebih banyak tiket dibanding rata-rata tiket per pelanggan yang punya tiket, beserta jumlah tiketnya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, tk.jumlah_tiket FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT t.customer_id AS customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS tk ON c.customer_id = tk.customer_id WHERE tk.jumlah_tiket > (SELECT avg(p.jumlah_tiket) FROM (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS p)

question: rasio pelanggan yg pernah punya deal lost dibanding semua pelanggan, hanya yg statusnya churned
sql: SELECT round(countIf(c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost')) / count(), 2) AS rasio_pernah_lost FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned'

question: Siapa sales yang deal terakhirnya (berdasarkan tanggal dibuat) berstatus won?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.rep_id IN (SELECT d.rep_id FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.rep_id HAVING argMax(d.stage, d.created_date) = 'won')

question: pelanggan yg tidak punya satupun deal berstatus lost, tampilkan jumlah saja
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost')

question: Pelanggan yang tidak punya tiket maupun aktivitas dalam 90 hari terakhir.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= subtractDays(now(), 90)) AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 90))

question: Per segmen, rasio pelanggan yang total omsetnya di atas rata-rata omset per pelanggan terhadap semua pelanggan segmen itu.
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(countIf(c.customer_id IN (SELECT o.customer_id FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS o WHERE o.total_omset > (SELECT avg(p.total_omset) FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS p))) / count(), 2) AS rasio_di_atas_rata FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.segment

question: customer yg tiket terakhirnya sudah closed dan nggak punya deal pipeline, list
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id HAVING argMax(t.status, t.created_at) = 'closed') AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation'))

question: Deal lost dengan nilai di atas rata-rata nilai deal lost.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost' AND d.value > (SELECT avg(d.value) FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost')

question: pelanggan yg tidak pernah punya aktivitas negatif, cukup id dan nama
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.sentiment = 'negative')

question: Cari pelanggan yang punya deal won tahun ini tetapi tidak punya deal won tahun lalu.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())) AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()))

question: Sales yang omsetnya bulan ini di atas rata-rata omset sales bulan ini, beserta peringkatnya.
sql: SELECT x.rep_id, x.name, x.total_omset, x.peringkat FROM (SELECT r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat, avg(sum(d.value)) OVER () AS rata_semua FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name) AS x WHERE x.total_omset > x.rata_semua ORDER BY x.peringkat

question: Rata-rata nilai deal per bulan pembuatan di tahun 2025, hanya bulan yang rata-ratanya di atas rata-rata seluruh deal.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.created_date) AS bulan, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE toYear(d.created_date) = 2025 GROUP BY bulan HAVING avg(d.value) > (SELECT avg(d.value) FROM deals AS d FINAL) ORDER BY bulan

question: Per segmen, berapa rata-rata jumlah tiket per pelanggan (hitung semua pelanggan segmen itu, yang tak punya tiket dihitung 0)?
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(sum(tk.jumlah_tiket) / count(), 2) AS rata_tiket_per_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.customer_id AS customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS tk ON c.customer_id = tk.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: jumlah aktivitas per sales per tipe yg lebih dari 100, tampilkan id sales, nama, tipe, jumlah
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, a.type, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, a.type HAVING count() > 100

question: Total omset per wilayah pelanggan dan persentil 90 omset per pelanggan dalam wilayah itu.
sql: SELECT o.wilayah, sum(o.total_omset) AS total_omset, quantile(0.9)(o.total_omset) AS p90_omset_pelanggan FROM (SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, c.customer_id AS customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY wilayah, c.customer_id) AS o GROUP BY o.wilayah
